fusions.name: Horn Check
fusions.desc: A lowered-head blow that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cliffside Kick
fusions.desc: A planted kick that costs 5% of your maximum health and deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Hooves
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 14%, and you have 8% earth resistance.
